title: AcmeDB: Fast, Unfinished, Single-Region
subject: AcmeDB
take: Fast on a laptop, not ready for production data.
summary: AcmeDB promises very fast reads, but its own docs say point-in-time snapshots and cross-region replication are not here yet. That leaves backup and resilience as roadmap items rather than shipped features. For anything you cannot afford to lose, that is the whole story.

receipts.evidence: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.

bottom_line: Skip AcmeDB for production until snapshots and replication ship. Revisit it only for disposable, local workloads.

quotes.text: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
